body.en: For equally spaced arguments $x_0, x_0 + h, \dots$, put $u = \frac{x - x_0}{h}$. Then $y_x = y_0 + u\Delta y_0 + \frac{u(u-1)}{2!}\Delta^2 y_0 + \frac{u(u-1)(u-2)}{3!}\Delta^3 y_0 + \dots$, stopping where differences become zero (or negligible). It is used to interpolate near the beginning of the table.

points.en: Best near the start of the table

narration.en: Put u equal to x minus x nought over h. Then y x equals y nought plus u delta y nought plus u into u minus one over two factorial delta squared y nought, and so on.
narration.kn: u = (x − x₀)/h ಎಂದಿಡಿ. ನಂತರ yₓ = y₀ + uΔy₀ + u(u−1)/2! Δ²y₀ + … ಹೀಗೆ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.
